title: webR Shiny Performance Benchmarks
text:
This page is a self-contained webR-powered Shiny application. It runs R entirely in your browser using WebAssembly. This approach eliminates the need for a traditional R server (like Shiny Server or Posit Connect), making it highly portable and scalable.



WebAssembly (Wasm): R is compiled to Wasm via the webR project.
Service Workers: The application uses a Service Worker to manage the webR lifecycle and cache assets.
Shinylive: This Quarto extension bundles the Shiny UI and server logic into the static page.
